Auth.signInDescription: Sign in to Sniptide to reach your pastes, share links and see how often they are opened.
Auth.signUpDescription: Create a Sniptide account to paste code, choose when each link expires and share it.
Auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to get to your pastes.
Auth.signInLegal: By continuing you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
Auth.signUpLegal: By creating an account you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
Auth.signInPitchBody: Paste code, choose when it expires, and share the link. Every paste shows how often it was opened.
Auth.expiresInDays: Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
Auth.signUpClosedSubtitle: Sign-up is closed on this instance. Ask the administrator if you need an account.
Auth.closedPitchBody: New accounts can't be created here right now. If you already have an account, sign in.
Auth.inviteOnlySubtitle: Sniptide is invite-only while it's in early access. Apply and we'll send you an invite.
Auth.invitePitchBody: Sniptide is still changing fast, so we're letting people in a few at a time. Apply and we'll add your email.
Auth.signUpSubtitle: Free for up to 100 MB of pastes.
Auth.signUpPitchBody: Public pastes are listed on your profile. Private and unlisted pastes are only visible through their link.
